text: Assumption: Containers provide iterators via common methods such as cbegin() and cend() — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Containers provide iterators via common methods such as cbegin() and cend() — is this correct?
norm: containers provide iterators via common methods such as cbegin and cend
assumption: Containers provide iterators via common methods such as cbegin() and cend().
rationale: The payload specifies only the operators of the iterator class, not the creation method of the enclosing container.
